pages.text: The next day, Julia gets back from class. Her best cup is in bits on the grass.
pages.picture: a broken teacup in pieces on the grass by the playhouse

pages.text: "Not again, Toby!" Toby just looks sad. Julia sighs.
pages.picture: the girl sighing, the dragon looking sad

pages.text: Then one day, Julia runs back fast and peeks in at the play house.
pages.picture: the girl tiptoeing and peeking into the playhouse doorway

pages.text: A big bee buzzes at Toby's nose. Buzz! Buzz!
pages.picture: a bee buzzing around the dragon's nose inside the playhouse

pages.text: Toby gets cross. His spikes stick up.
pages.picture: the dragon cross, his spikes bristling like a porcupine

pages.text: And then her dolls zoom up, high, high, high! Her drum zooms up. Her tea set zooms up!
pages.picture: dolls, a toy drum and a tea set shooting high into the air above the playhouse

pages.text: Crash! Bang! Smash! They all come down.
pages.picture: toys crashing down onto the grass
the girl staring, mouth open in amazement

pages.text: "Toby, you did that! That is so, so cool! Do it on me! Make me float!"
pages.picture: the girl jumping up and down with excitement

pages.text: Toby looks down. "I can not," he said. "I can not help it. I just get upset, and things zoom up and smash."
Julia thinks hard. Then she grins. "Then we will fix it," she said.
pages.picture: the girl with a determined grin
